title.narrative: North West Association of Women with Disabilities (NWAWWD)

description.narrative: NWAWWD works with women and girls living with disabilities, offering education on their rights, workshops on health & sexuality, and training about running small businesses. NWAWWD advocate in communities including public officials about the rights and issues of girls and women living with disabilities. The Equality Fund Grant will support North West Association of Women With Disabilities (NWAWWD) core operational mission costs, salaries and transportation including the following activities: -Train WWD in awareness of gender, disability, and humanitarian rights by meeting and collaborating with different agencies/actors. -Assist grassroots women's groups by providing essential materials for basic living standards, providing peer counseling, and supporting rehabilitation. -Conduct research on SGBV and other forms of violence pertaining to WWD needs; -Build knowledge & networks for humanitarian support, economic and personal security, through workshops run by skilled African WWD. Share findings, learnings and results with diverse communities where possible. -Create a local refugee coalition committee of WwD and other stakeholders to address needs of all WWD in refugee camps and displaced communities -Strengthen capacities of WWDs to live dignified, economically secure lives of social inclusion in society following the rights based approach. -Protect the safety of WWD in Bamenda and surrounding areas due to the increasing political conflict, violence and instability in Cameroun -Produce a film to support educational advocacy work
